{{Quote|Be thankful you can sense the Living Force, young Initiates. Outside the Jedi Temple you will discover an infinite variety of life-forms that contribute to the local energy field. All of them are worthy of a Jedi's protection. Xenobiology is a fascinating specialization!|Bowspritz|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Bowspritz''' was a [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], a noted [[Jedi Biologist|biologist]], and the [[Jedi Beast Master|beastmaster]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] preceding the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. Contributing research to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during his service, Bowspritz was immortalized in the Order after [[Author/Legends|authoring]] several chapters of the Temple guidebook titled ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. In those chapters, he passed down information on the [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|''Animals'' are what most call living creatures not outwardly capable of speech or mathematics. As a Jedi, you will sense that this distinction isn't so simple.|Bowspritz|<ref name="TJP" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]],<ref name="JCF" /> Bowspritz joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at a young age, and was accepted as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] some time before the outbreak of the [[New Sith Wars]]. While apprenticed to a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], the young Jedi spent a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] studying the [[Jodakan needler crab|needler crabs]] of [[Jodaka]] and updating the outdated material found in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] with the data gathered there. Bowspritz discovered and named the furred [[o'cerry]]s of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alchenaut]], and encountered both a slumbering [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorth]] and a [[Neebray/Legends|neebray manta]] in the depths of space. Furthermore, the Tynnan's research also extended to the [[Troiken indictidile]] and the [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeetan]] [[Whiteworm/Legends|whiteworm]]. Like most Jedi of the era, Master Bowspritz served the Order as a member of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]], regardless of a past in studying the ways of the [[Jedi Consular]], in the crusades against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. Once the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] took effect, Master Bowspritz returned to the Temple to continue studies on biology and [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] cultures.<ref name="TJP" />

At some point in Bowspritz's career, a number of run-ins with various [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] helped him out of several hazardous situations; however, Bowspritz would later recollect that those dealings exerted some strain on the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]]-line he received from the Temple. He also compiled societal and cultural information on other species including [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]. Bowspritz earned the title of [[Beastmaster/Legends|beastmaster]] after extensive research into the manifestations of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in galactic fauna. During a mission to the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] outpost on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] world [[Ord Canfre/Legends|Ord Canfre]], Master Bowspritz encountered an [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dog]] and in so doing discovered how the Force played a part in the bonds that the akks formed with their trainers.<ref name="TJP" />

When Bowspritz's contemporary Masters proposed that a [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force|guidebook]] to the life of the Jedi be written, the [[Jedi Biologist|biologist]] agreed to work on the project, [[Author/Legends|contributing]] three chapters. Describing in turn a galactic bestiary, advanced culture, and politics, Master Bowspritz's insights as a biologist and a Consular were meant to serve as the starting point for research into relations with different [[Species/Legends|species]] both [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient.<ref name="TJP" /> Published in [[990 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] was published a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] or more after the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], which ended in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Tynnan's writings were later annotated and critiqued by [[Thame Cerulian]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in a copy of the guidebook that ended up in each Jedi's subsequent possession.<ref name="TJP" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Creatures can be found to exist in nearly any environment&mdash;if there's one thing I am certain of, it's that the Force always finds a way.|Bowspritz|<ref name="TJP" />}}
Bowspritz held a deep fascination for xenobiology,<ref name="TJP" /> and was excitable about the subjects in which he was knowledgeable.<ref name="JCF" /> Moreover, he believed that the Force always found a way to exist within living things regardless of the environment.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bowspritz was first mentioned in the reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and released in [[2010]]. While Bowspritz's species is not identified in the book itself,<ref name="TJP" /> Wallace later released a list detailing the genders and species of each of the authors of the in-universe ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. In the list, Master Bowspritz is revealed to be a male Tynnan.<ref name="JCF" />
